71276-the-book-of-antelopes-vol-4-of-4.title: Book Of Antelopes.
71276-the-book-of-antelopes-vol-4-of-4.creator: Unknown
71276-the-book-of-antelopes-vol-4-of-4.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Skull heavily built; without supraorbital pits, with small or no lachrymal fissures, and without anteorbital fossæ. Molars very high and broad, and with accessory internal columns; therefore very similar to those of the Bovinæ, the subfamily containing the Oxen.

arxiv-1811-10403.creator: Elvira Albert 1, Pablo Gordillo 1, Albert Rubio 1, Ilya Sergey 2
arxiv-1811-10403.description: Abstract Gas is a measurement unit of the computational effort that it will take to execute every single operation that takes part in the Ethereum blockchain platform. Each instruction executed by the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) has an associated gas consumption specified by Ethereum.

arxiv-2011-12048.title: Decaying positive global solutions of second order difference equations with mean curvature operator
arxiv-2011-12048.creator: Zuzana Došlá, Serena Matucci, Pavel Řehák
arxiv-2011-12048.description: Abstract A boundary value problem on an unbounded domain, associated to difference equations with the Euclidean mean curvature operator is considered. The existence of solutions which are positive on the whole domain and decaying at infinity is examined by proving new Sturm comparison theorems for linear difference equations and using a fixed point approach based on a linearization device.

arxiv-2305-11409.title: Catalytic role of HI in the interstellar synthesis of complex organic molecule
arxiv-2305-11409.creator: Shuming Yang, Peng Xie, Enwei Liang, Zhao Wang
arxiv-2305-11409.description: Abstract Using quantum chemical calculations, we model the pathways for synthesizing two purine nucleobases, adenine and guanine, in the gas-phase interstellar environment, surrounded by neutral atomic hydrogen (HI). HI is found active in facilitating a series of fundamental proton transfer processes of organic synthesis, including bond formation, cyclization, dehydrogenation, and H migration.

arxiv-2308-00420.title: The complexity of the Timetable-Based Railway Network Design Problem
arxiv-2308-00420.creator: Nadine Friesen 1, Tim Sander 2, Christina Büsing 3, Karl Nachtigall 2, Nils Nießen 1
arxiv-2308-00420.description: Abstract Because of the long planning periods and their long life cycle, railway infrastructure has to be outlined long ahead. At the present, the infrastructure is designed while only little about the intended operation is known. Hence, the timetable and the operation are adjusted to the infrastructure.

arxiv-2308-02992.title: Binary Code Similarity Detection
arxiv-2308-02992.creator: Zian Liu
arxiv-2308-02992.description: Abstract Binary code similarity detection is to detect the similarity of code at binary (assembly) level without source code. Existing works have their limitations when dealing with mutated binary code generated by different compiling options. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to addressing this problem.

arxiv-2401-16111.title: Extracting Work From Two Gravitational Cat States
arxiv-2401-16111.creator: Maryam Hadipour, Soroush Haseli
arxiv-2401-16111.description: Abstract This work examines how a thermal environment affects the work that can be extracted from gravitational cat states. The purpose of this work is to provide an in-depth discussion of the effects of temperature and gravitational interaction between states with masses m m on work extraction.

arxiv-2402-15504.title: Gen4Gen : Generative Data Pipeline for Generative Multi-Concept Composition
arxiv-2402-15504.creator: Chun-Hsiao Yeh, Ta-Ying Cheng, He-Yen Hsieh, Chuan-En Lin, Andrew Markham, Niki Trigoni, H.T. Kung, Yubei Chen
arxiv-2402-15504.description: Abstract Recent text-to-image diffusion models are able to learn and synthesize images containing novel, personalized concepts (e.g., their own pets or specific items) with just a few examples for training. This paper tackles two interconnected issues within this realm of personalizing text-to-image diffusion models.

arxiv-2407-02710.title: WARNING This Contains Misinformation: The Effect of Cognitive Factors, Beliefs, and Personality on Misinformation Warning Tag Attitudes
arxiv-2407-02710.creator: Robert Kaufman, Aaron Broukhim, Michael Haupt
arxiv-2407-02710.description: Abstract . Social media platforms enhance the propagation of online misinformation by providing large user bases with a quick means to share content. One way to disrupt the rapid dissemination of misinformation at scale is through warning tags, which label content as potentially false or misleading. Past warning tag mitigation studies yield mixed results for diverse audiences, however.

arxiv-2505-10448.title: Efficient MCMC Sampling with Expensive-to-Compute and Irregular Likelihoods
arxiv-2505-10448.creator: Conor Rosato, Harvinder Lehal, Simon Maskell, Lee Devlin, Malcolm Strens
arxiv-2505-10448.description: Abstract Bayesian inference with Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) is challenging when the likelihood function is irregular and expensive to compute. We explore several sampling algorithms that make use of subset evaluations to reduce computational overhead. We adapt the subset samplers for this setting where gradient information is not available or is unreliable.

arxiv-2506-18137.title: High-power RF amplifier for ultracold atom experiments
arxiv-2506-18137.creator: Premjith Thekkeppatt, Edwin Baaij, Tijs van Roon, Klaasjan van Druten, Florian Schreck
arxiv-2506-18137.description: Abstract We report on the design and characterization of a high-power amplifier with an output power of 36.5 dBm for a frequency range of 50 MHz to 1000 MHz with a total gain of 40 dB. The amplifier is optimized for driving acousto-optic and electro-optic modulators for ultracold atom experiments.

arxiv-2509-02739.title: On stable solutions to the Allen–Cahn equation with bounded energy density in ℝ 4 \mathbb{R}^{4}
arxiv-2509-02739.creator: Enric Florit-Simon, Joaquim Serra
arxiv-2509-02739.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Enric Florit-Simon, Joaquim Serra. We show that stable solutions u : ℝ 4 → ( − 1 , 1 ) u:\mathbb{R}^{4}\to(-1,1) to the Allen–Cahn equation with bounded energy density (or equivalently, with cubic energy growth) are one-dimensional. This is known to entail important geometric consequences, such as robust curvature estimates for stable phase transitions, and the multiplicity one and Morse index conjectures of Marques–Neves for Allen–Cahn approximations of minimal hypersurfaces in closed 4-manifolds.

arxiv-2510-04573.title: LaDiR: Latent Diffusion Enhances LLMs for Text Reasoning
arxiv-2510-04573.creator: Haoqiang Kang, Yizhe Zhang, Nikki Lijing Kuang, Nicklas Majamaki, [4pt] Navdeep Jaitly, Yi-An Ma, Lianhui Qin, [6pt] University of California, San Diego
arxiv-2510-04573.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate their reasoning ability through chain-of-thought (CoT) generation. However, LLM’s autoregressive decoding may limit the ability to revisit and refine earlier tokens in a holistic manner, which can also lead to inefficient exploration for diverse solutions.

pmc-10535789.title: Bovine Viral Diarrhea Virus Antibody Level Variation in Newborn Calves after Vaccination of Late-Gestational Cows
pmc-10535789.creator: Ui-Hyung Kim, Sung-Sik Kang, Sun-Sik Jang, Sung Woo Kim, Ki-Yong Chung, Dong-Hun Kang, Bo-Hye Park, Seungmin Ha
pmc-10535789.description: Simple SummaryWe confirmed that a large number of new antibodies are generated in the body of the mother after BVDV vaccination in late-stage pregnancy in beef cattle. We also observed a slow decline in BVDV maternal antibodies in calves born to pregnant cows that produced high levels of BVDV antibodies following pre-calving BVDV vaccination.

pmc-10578441.title: Targeting the pericyte antigen DLK1 with an alpha type-1 polarized dendritic cell vaccine results in tumor vascular modulation and protection against colon cancer progression
pmc-10578441.creator: Amanda L. McCormick, Trevor S. Anderson, Elizabeth A. Daugherity, Izuchukwu F. Okpalanwaka, Savanna L. Smith, Duke Appiah, Devin B. Lowe
pmc-10578441.description: Despite the availability of various treatment options, colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a significant contributor to cancer-related mortality. Current standard-of-care interventions, including surgery, chemotherapy, and targeted agents like immune checkpoint blockade and anti-angiogenic therapies, have improved short-term patient outcomes depending on disease stage, but survival rates with metastasis remain low.

pmc-11633488.title: Membrane Associated RNA‐Containing Vesicles Regulate Cortical Astrocytic Microdomain Calcium Transients in Awake Ischemic Stroke Mice
pmc-11633488.creator: Zhongqiu Zhou, Ying Bai, Xiaochun Gu, Hui Ren, Wen Xi, Yu Wang, Liang Bian, Xue Liu, Ling Shen, Xianyuan Xiang, Wenhui Huang, Zhuojuan Luo, Bing Han, Honghong Yao
pmc-11633488.description: Astrocytic processes minutely regulate neuronal activity via tripartite synaptic structures. The precision‐tuning of the function of astrocytic processes is garnering increasing attention because of its significance in promoting brain repair following ischemic stroke. Microdomain calcium (Ca2+) transients in astrocytic processes are pivotal for the functional regulation of these processes.

pmc-11662626.title: Risk Factors of Esophageal Fistula Associated with Volumetric Modulated Arc Therapy for Esophageal Squamous Cell Cancer
pmc-11662626.creator: Jinyun Wang, Xiaowei Wu, Ge Hu
pmc-11662626.description: PurposeTo investigate risk factors for esophageal fistula in esophageal squamous cell cancer (ESCC) patients who treated with volumetric modulated arc therapy (VMAT).Patients and MethodsA retrospective analysis was performed on 171 ESCC patients treated with VMAT at Hefei Cancer Hospital, Chinese Academy of Sciences, from February 2017 to February 2021.

pmc-12378698.title: A cognitive multiplex network approach to investigate mental navigation and predict high-level cognition
pmc-12378698.creator: Ofir Ganor, Gal Samuel, Massimo Stella, Yoed N Kenett
pmc-12378698.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). High-level cognition, such as intelligence and creativity, are considered the hallmark of human cognition; however, their complexity hinders the identification of underlying common mechanisms. We focus on one such likely mechanism—mental navigation. We utilize converging computational methods to demonstrate how mental navigation—operationalized via verbal fluency tasks—predicts individual differences in creativity, intelligence, and openness to experience (the personality trait most closely related to them).

pmc-12540035.title: Strand-specific quantification of 8-oxo-dG and apurinic sites via Ligation-Dependent Probe Amplification (LPA)
pmc-12540035.creator: Antonella Romano, Antonia Feola, Valentina Morgera, Alfonso Tramontano, Samantha Messina, Daniel Gackowski, Ewelina Zarakowska, Ryszard Olinski, Vittorio Enrico Avvedimento, Candida Zuchegna, Antonio Porcellini, Antonio Pezone
pmc-12540035.description: Oxidative DNA damage, characterized by the prominent lesion 8-oxo-7,8-dihydroguanine (8-oxo-dG), is linked to mutagenesis and genome instability. Accurately mapping these lesions with strand specificity and high resolution remains a major challenge, limiting our understanding of damage dynamics during transcription and repair.

pmc-13091264.title: Therapeutic potential of low-dose rosiglitazone in periodontitis: attenuation of inflammation and bone loss through macrophage reprogramming
pmc-13091264.creator: Li-Na Zhou, Zheng Zhang, Zhi-Tao Wang
pmc-13091264.description: ObjectivesThis study aimed to investigate the effects of different dosages of the peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPAR-γ) agonist rosiglitazone on macrophage polarization, the expression of related inflammatory factors, and alveolar bone loss in the periodontal tissues of rats with experimental periodontitis, thereby providing experimental evidence supporting the potential use of rosiglitazone as a therapeutic agent for periodontitis.

pmc-13241757.title: Impact of salvage treatment for recurrent medulloblastoma in previously irradiated patients (KROG 23-02): A multi-institutional retrospective study
pmc-13241757.creator: Seok-Joo Chun, Nalee Kim, Do Hoon Lim, Joo-Young Kim, Chan Woo Wee, Hong In Yoon, Seung Hyuck Jeon, In Ah Kim, Joo Ho Lee
pmc-13241757.description: Highlights•Multimodal salvage therapy is associated with improved survival in relapse.•Chemotherapy positively correlates with prolonged progression-free and OS.•Modern re-irradiation provides a feasible option with acceptable safety.Keywords: Medulloblastoma, Recurrence, Salvage, Radiotherapy, Surgery, Chemotherapy Introduction Medulloblastoma is the most common malignant brain tumor in children, accounting for approximately 20% of all pediatric central nervous system (CNS) neoplasms [1], [2].

pmc-13513306.title: Modulation of Obesity-Related Lipid Metabolism by Sulforaphane Through AMPK-Centered Molecular Networks
pmc-13513306.creator: Uyory Choe
pmc-13513306.description: Sulforaphane (SFN), an isothiocyanate produced from glucoraphanin in cruciferous vegetables, has been associated with the regulation of lipid storage, fatty acid oxidation, and autophagic lipid turnover. Therefore, in the current narrative review, AMPK-centered mechanisms were critically evaluated by distinguishing pathway association from experimentally demonstrated AMPK dependence.
